messages:
ravi: Kickoff: pen-test intake for BetaCorp. Need to nail RBAC windows, KMS scoping, and how we collect exploit evidence.

nina: I can coordinate evidence ingestion. Preference: readroom for live verification, presigned urls for bulk artifacts.

zach: Readroom gives better chain-of-custody. presigned as fallback only. Also note staging will get a KMS alias rotation mid-week.

maggie: Which alias? we must avoid rotating the key used by the evidence bucket during the retest window.

deploy-bot: Upcoming rotation scheduled: alias/redwood-staging-rotate -> 2025-10-10T05:00Z.

ravi: Copy. We'll set export cutoff 2025-10-10T04:00Z and snapshot CloudTrail/KMS logs beforehand.

nina: For ephemeral access: provision STS sessions that only permit S3:GetObject on prefix `pt/evidence/<ticket>/` and kms:Decrypt on alias/redwood-pt-evidence. No kms:Encrypt or kms:GenerateDataKey.

zach: Also add condition restriction so decrypt only allowed when session tag `pt-ticket` equals the JIRA id. Prevent reuse.

maggie: Good. Add CloudTrail data-events for S3 object-level and KMS API calls for the evidence key during the assessor windows.

sec-bot: Runbook patch pushed: /runbooks/pt-retest (rev c3). Data-event job queued.

ravi: Verification checklist I'm proposing: PR merged -> staging deploy -> smoke tests -> assessor exploit in readroom -> upload signed manifest + artifacts -> export cloudtrail.

nina: Manifest format: newline JSONL with fields path,sha256,uploaded_by,ts,jira; detach-signed by uploader's key. We'll require SHA256 and file size.

zach: I'll draft a small uploader tool that computes sha256 and signs the manifest; will also generate presigned url fallback.

maggie: On RBAC window length: default 90m, can extend with approval to 3h max. Also rotate session every 25 minutes during the window.

ravi: Sounds good. Who owns logs export?

nina: I'll own exports. Will upload manifest and CloudTrail bundle to s3://pt-evidence/3129994321/ and link in JIRA.

sec-bot: Actions created: PT-1201 (uploader script), PT-1202 (kms-scope PR), PT-1203 (cloudtrail export), PT-1204 (schedule retest).

zach: PR opened: https://git.internal/infra/pull/901 (ephemeral-role + kms scoping). tagging review.

maggie: I'll review PR and confirm session rotation automation. Also adding a preflight checklist step to verify KMS alias mapping in infra before retest.

ravi: Timeline: dry-run Wed 2025-10-08 14:00 UTC, live retest Mon 2025-10-13 09:00 UTC. Owners: nina (evidence+exports), zach (iam/kms), maggie (ops liaison).

nina: I'll post sample manifest and uploader README by EOD.

zach: CloudTrail export scheduled and will be placed next to manifest after snapshot.

maggie: Tag all tickets with `pt-verify-YYYYMMDD` and attach S3 paths.

ravi: OK closing. Final preflight 2025-10-09 11:00 UTC. Thanks all.
